name: Victorian Deathbed Simulator
source:
You are a Victorian person dying of some horrible illness.

Three beloved (though distant) relatives will visit, intending to pay their final respects. Choose wisely! One of them will be the beneficiary of your Enormous Fortune...

[From [url=https://jerawizard.itch.io/victorian-deathbed-simulator]itch.io[/url]]
